notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.content:
[h1]Prologue Update:[/h1]
[h2]Prologue released:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Approx. 40 Minute “New York Fallen” Prologue unlocked
[*] New Double Barrel Shotgun
[*] [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] We’re still working on the balancing of the story. Easy may still
be too easy, and hard may be too difficult. Or easy may already be too 
hard. 
[/list]
[h2]Known-Issues: [/h2]
[list]
[*] The transition from Story to Wave-mode may cause a crash
[/list]
[h2]Wave-mode: [/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer necessary to raise hands in wave-mode pauses
[*] Visual improvements on Takeout background walls
[/list]
[h2]Bhaptics: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Bhaptics now supported (Tested with Tac40)
[/list]
[h2]Enemies: [/h2]
[list]
[*] New skin for zombie hounds
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Resolved:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Log file no longer gets overloaded 
[*] Haptic vest should work more reliably
[*] Fixed issue that resulted in fatal crash at the start of metro level
[*] Fog plane has been updated on multiple maps
[*] In-Game Player Menu updated
[*] Removed unnecessary decimal points on widgets
[*] Host leaving warning now shows up on clients
[*] Crawler Rag-doll no longer jettisons into the air
[*] Flaregun particle system optimization 
[*] Added Zombie Dog “remains” 
[*] Spitters can no-longer hide in unshootable spots
[*] Widget interactions can now be done with both hands simultaneously
[*] Ghost mesh is hidden by default (occasionally showed up incorrectly) 
[*] Music selection on Jukebox in Waveshooter improved
[/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Day One Patch Notes:[/h2]

[b]UZI Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced recoil to provide a smoother shooting experience.
[*] Increased damage output for greater effectiveness in combat.
[*] Adjusted gun-to-hand rotation for improved handling and accuracy.
[/list]
[b]Shotgun Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the price of shotgun ammunition to make it more accessible and cost-effective.
[/list]
[b]Zombie Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hazmat zombies will now appear earlier on Danger 0, increasing the variety and intensity of encounters right from the start. Brace yourself for some hazardous encounters!
[/list]
[b]Lobby Music Polishes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made various improvements and refinements to the lobby music.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing players from unlocking Danger 2 and Danger 3. Now you can progress further and face even greater challenges!
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope these adjustments and fixes enhance your gameplay and make your journey through the game even more enjoyable. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content in the future!

tags.balance_change: [*] Reduced recoil to provide a smoother shooting experience.

[*] Adjusted gun-to-hand rotation for improved handling and accuracy.
[*] Reduced the price of shotgun ammunition to make it more accessible and cost-effective.
[*] Hazmat zombies will now appear earlier on Danger 0, increasing the variety and intensity of encounters right from the start. Brace yourself for some hazardous encounters!

notes.title: Rotten Apple Multiplayer Beta Mayhem - A PCVR Zombie Shooter Showdown
notes.content:
Rotten Apple VR: The Ultimate Zombie Shooter Multiplayer Beta Blasts Onto Steam

Grab your VR headset and prepare for an adrenaline-pumping adventure! We are thrilled to announce the launch of the highly-anticipated multiplayer Beta for Rotten Apple, the groundbreaking VR Zombie Shooter, exclusively on Steam.

Set in a post-apocalyptic New York City overrun by the undead, Rotten Apple invites players to join forces with fellow survivors in an immersive, heart-pounding virtual reality experience. With its cutting-edge graphics, realistic sound effects, and dynamic gameplay, Rotten Apple pushes the boundaries of VR technology to deliver the most exhilarating zombie shooter yet.

Key features of Rotten Apple include:

[list]
[*] Intense Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with friends or other players from around the globe to take on relentless hordes of zombies in an immersive story or the brand-new endless mode. 

[*] Diverse Arsenal & Customization: Choose from an extensive range of weapons and upgrade them to suit your playstyle. 

[*] Massive Enemy Encounters: Face off against hordes of diverse adversaries, providing a thrilling challenge and non-stop action as you navigate through intense, large-scale battles in a dynamic PCVR gaming experience.
[/list]

Beta access for Rotten Apple is now available on Steam, and we invite gamers from around the world to join the frontlines of this epic battle against the undead. Your feedback is crucial in helping us fine-tune the gameplay, iron out any kinks, and create the ultimate VR zombie shooter experience. Together, let's put the rotten back in the Big Apple!

For more information and updates, follow Rotten Apple on social media and visit our official website at https://rottenapple-vr.com/.


About VRilliant:
VRilliant is a leading developer of innovative virtual reality games, committed to creating unique and immersive experiences for gamers worldwide. With a passion for storytelling and cutting-edge technology, the team at VRilliant strives to push the boundaries of VR gaming.
